cases.cause: Synthetic management_hold was a dict; the actual column is UUID.
cases.resolution: Use a UUID fixture; the 1-versus-50 channel query count and resource facts pass.

cases.cause: One older internal test called JobAdministration.list(state=...) after the unified QueueQuery signature was introduced. Initial full run: 632 passed, 1 failed.
cases.resolution: Update the internal caller to QueueQuery(state=queued); final full run passes 634 tests. One intermediate run was interrupted before acceptance because an atomic patch had not applied.

cases.cause: Playwright wait_for_function(string) evaluated under the existing strict CSP.
cases.resolution: Poll direct CDP evaluation without changing application CSP; final hidden/visible/logout checks pass.

cases.cause: The reused native-provider cleanup helper deliberately rejected a queue-load directory outside its own allowed root.
cases.resolution: Use an explicitly checked queue-load run root and direct child targets. Manually verified and cleaned the first failed run; subsequent failed/successful runs report full cleanup.

cases.cause: Nested synchronous response.json() callbacks could overwrite a newer test observation with an older response.
cases.resolution: Retain monotonic preparing counts in the measurement observer; rendered DOM and fresh snapshot checks pass for all 30 samples. Product refresh uses cancellation and current request identity.

cases.cause: A one-shot mock error was immediately followed by an SSE-triggered successful refresh, hiding the error before the assertion.
cases.resolution: Keep the synthetic failure active until the scenario ends; same-filter data preservation and error display pass.

cases.cause: PathInfo.Parent was null in the archive wrapper; a separate foreach redirection was parsed as a command after all four browser scripts had passed.
cases.resolution: Resolve the archive path explicitly and run native regression successfully. All four browser evidence reports were checked directly: 10+11+6+5 groups, no runtime errors, contexts closed.
